findings: Native HolderL on the SAME measure maps original Lp2 pair to Lp1, with actual representative binding.
Difference of squares equals actual Holder product of difference and sum; opnorm and triangle give exact norm error bound.
Actual continuous integral square Lp1 class is proved equal to original cutoff output squared. Every original L2 input approximation therefore yields actual output-square convergence in L1.
scope_limits: No unjustified L4 or L2 bracket requirement, no time-uniform or pathwise convergence claim from this estimate alone.
Successor WIP, not publicly adopted or integrated by this review. Whole theory OPEN.
